title: Early warning: protect the CN-001 property deposit before the facility tightens

derivation.step: Trigger is on a metric the bank already monitors daily
derivation.value: facility LTV, not a market forecast
65% - five points before the 70% margin call

evidence_chain.label: SGD 8,000,000 drawn, LTV 59.15%
evidence_chain.detail: Secured on PF-0002, which is 98% Bara.

evidence_chain.label: SGD 9,000,000 property deposit, 2027-03-01 to 2027-06-30
evidence_chain.detail: Certainty: Likely. RM note 2026-04-14 confirms a Bukit Timah property, around SGD 9m.

evidence_chain.label: The only realistic source of both the deposit and any collateral cure
evidence_chain.detail: PF-0002 cannot fund either without selling the shareholding he has refused to reduce.

projected_consequence.summary: If the facility reaches 65% LTV, the cure and the SGD 9m deposit draw on the same portfolio within months of each other. Funding both from PF-0001 leaves the household MORE concentrated in Bara, not less - the diversified assets are the ones that get sold.

items.label: Liquid mandate assets, PF-0001
items.value: SGD 36.3m across daily-liquid funds and cash

items.label: Concentration after funding both from PF-0001
items.value: Bara rises above 41.42% of household wealth

actions.action: Ring-fence SGD 9m of PF-0001 daily-liquid assets against CN-001 now, and exclude them from the CF-0005 cure path.
actions.rationale: Two claims on one pool is the actual risk. Naming which assets serve which claim removes it.
actions.second_order: Constrains rebalancing inside PF-0001 for six months.

actions.action: Repay SGD 2m of CF-0005 from PF-0001 cash, taking LTV to roughly 44%.
actions.rationale: Buys headroom ahead of both events.
actions.second_order: Gives up the leverage he took the facility for, and he is currently positive on energy.

actions.action: Bring the deposit forward or fund it from outside the bank.
actions.second_order: Outside our visibility; may not be available. Requires asking about family group liquidity, which touches the topic he closed down in January.

client_script.opening: You mentioned the Bukit Timah deposit in April - around SGD 9m, early next year. I want to make sure that money and the loan are not queuing for the same assets.
key_points: The deposit and any top-up on the loan would both come out of the managed portfolio.
If we fund both from there, the share of your wealth sitting in the family company goes up, not down - which is the opposite of what you asked this relationship to do.
We can ring-fence the deposit now and it costs you nothing.
client_script.likely_objection: That the loan is comfortable today at 59%.
client_script.response: It is. It was also 78.5% in December, and it came back down because coal prices rose, not because we did anything. I would rather not depend on that twice.

checks.detail: PF-0001 holds sufficient daily-liquid assets today

checks.check: Liquidity coverage for CN-001 AND a CF-0005 cure
checks.detail: Both claims land within the same two quarters
Funding both from PF-0001 increases relative concentration in the operating business

assumptions: Single factor: every move is driven by one Brent shock. Cross-asset and idiosyncratic risk is not modelled.
Betas are OLS through the origin on the four snapshot-to-snapshot returns (Bara beta 0.721, R2 1.00). Four observations is an assumption, not a risk model.
FX held at 2026-08-26. A Brent fall would plausibly move USDIDR, which moves the SGD value of the Bara collateral. Not modelled.
instruments.csv gives no barrier or strike for SYN-SP-0505, so no knock-in is modelled and none is assumed.

confidence.basis: Trigger is on a facility metric the bank computes daily. No market forecast is involved.
what_we_would_check: Whether CN-001 is contractually committed or still indicative
Whether the property purchase can be debt-financed separately

decision_log.note: Liquidity collision detected between CN-001 and the CF-0005 cure path
